tours.name: Getting started
tours.description: A short tour that crosses from one page to another.

steps.title: Welcome
steps.content: This tour runs across two pages. Use Next to move through it.

steps.title: Where you are
steps.content: The tour anchors to elements by CSS selector, so it points at real controls.

steps.title: Something to point at
steps.content: Steps with no page of their own stay on whatever page the tour is already on.

steps.title: A different page
steps.content: This step lives on the Settings page, so choosing Next on the previous step saved your position and brought you here. Reload now and the tour picks up where it left off, because the position is on the server rather than in this tab.

steps.title: Finding it again
steps.content: A host project would put its own control here. Finishing marks the tour complete.
